website.data: ScreenFab Skip to content Catalog Locations Rollformed Screens Patio Door Screens Contact EST. 2011 Welcome to ScreenFab The premier screen manufacturer for windows and doors selling directly to manufacturers and installers About Us Our goal is to provide our customers with innovative and quality products while still maintaining the customer service of a small-business. Our team here at ScreenFab is an experienced and professional family dedicated to meeting the screen needs of our customers. In April 2011, we established ScreenFab LLC with the goal of focusing our business practices on customer orientation and quality products. Although we are a new company, our team has over thirty years of experience in the screen industry. We remain dedicated to maintaining the customer service and ideals of a small business while still offering the resources of a growing company. Our experience allows us to find and create innovative products to help improve the manufacturing and installation of window and patio screens. Window screens and coverings have been an integral part of building construction since the earliest parts of human history. As technologies advance, we hope to continue providing excellent products to our customer base. Today, screens can block out the majority of the sun's rays, offer protection against scratches and tears, and provide better air quality. Our dedicated team of sales and customer service representatives are available to help you better understand our products and answer any questions you have. Frequently Asked Questions Who does ScreenFab sell to? Collapse Our customers are window manufacturers, glass shops, screen shops, OEM businesses, and more. As a wholesale company, ScreenFab does not sell to the public. However, give us a call and we would be happy to refer you to one of our customers in your area. How do I become a ScreenFab dealer? Expand Just give us a call 888.519.1278 or email us at services@screenfabs.com . It just takes a few forms to start buying with us today. How do I place an order? Expand Orders can be emailed or faxed to your local branch. Find location information here and download our order forms here. Do you install screens? Expand We manufacture screens, but do not install them. However, if you have any questions about installing our products, give us a call or stop by one of our offices and speak with one of our salespersons.
